people.name: Adramyttium
people.line: A seaport in Asia Minor, visited by Paul.

people.name: Aristarchus
people.line: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner

people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

people.name: Thessalonica
people.line: Macedonian city, site of an early Christian church

translations.web: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
translations.bsb: We boarded an Adramyttian ship about to sail for ports along the coast of Asia, and we put out to sea. Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was with us.
translations.kjv: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
translations.asv: And embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail unto the places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
